bundle_argument: deprecated compatibility argument; accepted, warned, and ignored; do not copy or serialize a bundle
input_contract: Existing Seurat object and explicit named source-function parameters; reference/query for mapping or annotation; gene_ids for enrichment
output_contract: list(result=<unchanged upstream return>, diagnostics=<function, versions, warnings, parameters>)
side_effects: dependencies are attached only inside a fresh Rscript worker
caller options, search path, .libPaths(), RNG state, and input object are preserved
worker errors include the worker log and are raised to the caller
upstream plotting/saving remains controlled by explicit parameters
parameters: Match original upstream arguments; no automatic threshold/data/split choice. Read source and family page before use.
process_contract: srt and parameters must be serializable across processes; functions must close over their dependencies or use explicit namespaces; implicit parent-session options/futures/BiocParallel settings are not inherited
